disposition: Deletion evidence is retained behind a consumer-floor watermark that never advances past the slowest consumer, is held for seated-but-silent members and backup chains, and counter deletion markers replicate delete-wins; the contract is public on the backup/compaction seams. Attachment and revision tombstone kinds do not exist because those families do not replicate (see PB-5028/PB-5030), and no pull-destination deletion policy exists.
